page.layout: One page of text; running head at top with page number; main text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (Dionysius, Geta, Noricum, Pannonii, Mysi, Thraces, Claud., Ovid., Stat., Lucan., Ausonius) and a short note in the left margin at the top.

main_text.p: Impulit,& magno gens est damnata triumpho. Stat.Syl.lib.1. Gloria devositam Dacis pereuntibus urbem Pandere.
main_text.head: EVROPÆ RELIQVÆ DEscriptio, & primùm populorum ad Austrum accolarum Danubij.
main_text.p: Dionysius. Geta. Noricum. Pannonij. Mysi. Thraces.A D Austrum autem Gerra,& Noricia urbes munita: Pannonij, Mysiq, magis boreales Thracibus, Ipsiq Thraces immensam terram habentes.
Pannonij,qui & Pæones olim,& iis vicini Mysi.

p.i: Iam plaga Pannonia,miserandáque mœnia Thracum, Aruáque Mysorum:iam nulli flebile damnum, Sed cursus solemnis erat,campúsque furori Expositus,sensúmque malis detraxerat ʋsus.
Nunc tibi Pannonia est,nunc Illyris ora domanda, Rhætica nunc prabent,Thraciáque arma metum: Hunc quoque pérque nouem timuit Pamphilia messes: Pannoniúsque ferox.
Nunc furor incubuit,nec iunƈto Sarmata velox Pannonios, Dacifque Getes admislus:habenti Tam pauidum tibi Roma ducem fortuna pepercit. Imperiis grauidas aluo Pannonias.

page.notes: Several marginal reference notes are faint and partly illegible; the reading of the Greek-looking ornament and the small left-margin note at the top is uncertain. The catchword TRA- is set at the lower right.
